meta.name: Moon and four planets, evening twilight off Cape May (spherical Earth)
meta.notes: The planet parade of February 2025 seen from a ship at anchor off Cape May, New Jersey, in evening nautical twilight: the Moon's lower limb, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn, with Polaris and Capella to close the northern sky. Synthetic, zero noise; raw sextant readings built by tools/reference/gen_moon_sights.py from Skyfield + JPL DE440s on a spherical Earth of radius 6378.14 km, the Earth CONVENTIONS section 1 reduces sights on. No observation carries a geocentric block: every direction comes from the ephemeris (ephemeris mode auto).
